measurements.state: Powered; at rest; original battery and PIR connected; programmer disconnected
measurements.purpose: Establish operating voltage directly at U2 candidate supply pin5 against confirmed ground; rail topology remains separate.
measurements.raw_user_statement:
PetSafe U2: measure its local supply voltage / v0.9.39
B76 red UV / black NS (Powered; at rest; original battery and PIR connected; programmer disconnected): 6.3

interpretation: U2 candidate supply pin5 measured 6.3 V relative to Q8 confirmed ground. Stability was not supplied. This agrees numerically with the earlier RF-supply and N-gate readings and differs from the earlier printed-VDD reading of4.5V. Those readings were not simultaneous, so no rail join is inferred and no fault is diagnosed. B74/B75 resistances24/48ohm remain unexplained; the drawn direct U2-to-VDD assignment is disputed.
candidate_qualification: If the fitted U2 is SN74LVC2G14 and these are its supply/ground pins,6.3V is above the manufacturer recommended5.5V operating maximum. Keep identity and supply assignment qualified; do not treat absolute maximum as an operating recommendation or infer device failure.
next_action: B80 CP (C7 upper end) to RT (R5 upper end); B81 PS (C6 upper end) to RB (R5 lower end). Battery/programmer disconnected, resistance mode. These test whether marked 22-ohm R5 is the missing supply resistor; its current output-branch placement is inferred.

sources.description: TI primary product specification: recommended VCC1.65-5.5V. Fitted identity remains a candidate.
